input:
CATEGORY: 在/正在 ongoing (Coherence: temporality)
definition: Use 在/正在 for a dynamic action that is ongoing. Do not use it when the sentence is only stating a location or does not emphasize an ongoing action.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (3 distinct):
2 | here is not emphasizing “ongoing”
1 | 在ongoing
1 | 一直在+V., emphasizing always ongoing

HER CORRECTIONS (5 of 5):
[mengmu_samples#21/f7/p0/k0/e0] 孟子不是[-在]看商店的员工  || her note: here is not emphasizing “ongoing”
[shennong_samples#50/f1/p0/k0-1/e3] 也看到了很多人[+在]吃植物  || her note: 在ongoing
[mengmu_samples#17/f0/p1/k0/e0] 孟子[一直学了→一直在学习]很多东西  || her note: 一直在+V., emphasizing always ongoing
[mengmu_samples#21/f7/p0/k0/e1] 就是[-在]跟其他的孩子玩商店的游戏  || her note: here is not emphasizing “ongoing”
[mengmu_samples#13/f2/p0/k0/e0] 而是因为住在那里以后孟子[一直在没读书→一直没在读书]

output.rule: Use 在/正在 before a dynamic verb when the action is ongoing; use 一直在+V. to emphasize that it is always ongoing. Do not use 在 when the sentence only states what someone does and does not emphasize an ongoing action.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: use/remove 在 because <action> is/is not emphasized as ongoing.

examples.explanation: 也看到了很多人吃植物 → 也看到了很多人在吃植物: use 在 because eating is ongoing.
一直学了很多东西 → 一直在学习很多东西: use 一直在+V. because the learning is emphasized as always ongoing.
孟子不是在看商店的员工 → 孟子不是看商店的员工: remove 在 because this does not emphasize an ongoing action.
就是在跟其他的孩子玩商店的游戏 → 就是跟其他的孩子玩商店的游戏: remove 在 because this does not emphasize an ongoing action.
一直在没读书 → 一直没在读书: put 没 before 在 for “has always not been studying.”

output.not_an_error: Do not flag a sentence for lacking 在 when it only states what someone does and does not emphasize an ongoing action.
